👀 Gustavo #Varela, #Monza's Portuguese striker, scored another brace in the victory against #Fiorentina.#Inter has been following him for a long time and considers him a possible option for the summer: their directors have gone to watch him live several times.#Napoli, that has already spoken with his agent, and #Juventus are also keeping a close eye on him. #Barcelona and #Arsenal sent scouts.The latest news is that next week his entourage is going to meet with #Monza to discuss his future and all the possibilities on the table.[@DiMarzio via @PuebloJ]

🧐🔋 #Spalletti is considering an extensive squad rotation against Omonia also taking into account the subsequent league feature against #Como. On Thursday, several players who have seen less playing time so far could therefore find space, in order to manage the energy of the starters. A possible return for #Conceição as well: to be seen if from the first minute or off the bench.[Sky Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

🔙🤞 Positive feelings for Nico #González and #Kalulu, both improving and potentially available for the away match against #Como. No rushing things, when the bianconero medical staff evaluating their progress day by day.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]

🚑 Kerim #Alajbegović's medical tests at #Juventus ruled out more serious issues: he has a muscular overload in his left leg.He had left the pitch at halftime against #Venezia.For now, there is no fixed timetable for his return: the muscle's day-to-day response will set the pace.#Juve's priority is to avoid any risk of a relapse or the issue worsening.Luciano #Spalletti is awaiting daily updates from the medical staff to know whether he will have him available for the Europa League game against Omonia, on Thursday in the Allianz Stadium, or if it is better to give him a precautionary rest.[@junews24com via @PuebloJ]
